parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records is `MockAudioPlayerForController` located in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/AudioPlayerControllerTests.swift`, which is a test file. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is a test fixture must be treated as intentional duplication. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.75) between `MP3Streamer+Playback` and `MockAudioPlayerForController` is expected: the mock deliberately mirrors the shape of the production type it stands in for, and lifting shared logic into production code would couple production semantics to test-fixture semantics.
